content: निश्चयः .²1 Ascertainment, investigation, inquiry. .²2 A fixed opinion, settled or firm conviction, firm belief. .²3 A determination, resolution, resolve; एष मे स्थिरो निश्चयः <ls>Mu. 1</ls>. .²4 Certainty, positiveness, positive conclusion. .²5 Fixed intention, design, purpose, aim; कैकेयी क्रूरनिश्चया <ls>R. 12. 4</ls>; <ls>Ku. 5. 5</ls>. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a figure in Rhetoric.
